researchNotes: All original authors preserved. Local pin mappings were reconciled against live title, source and author before saving; historical local IDs were not trusted after the database restore.

Primary datasets read: ERCOT 26INR0635; MISO J3762/J3931/J3994/J3454; SPP GEN-2017-195 and GEN-2021-006; NYISO queue 1080; PJM AG2-675/AH1-482/AH1-563/AG1-411. EIA August 2026 existing/retired plant coordinates are context markers, not new-project parcel surveys.

Current CAISO workbook has no exact Muon/Boson name. This is not evidence of cancellation. Barnstable QP1543 appears in search indexing, but repeated official live-table redirects prevented primary read-back; parcel, MWh and applicant remain unverified.

Seventeen unpublished price estimates and three calculated energy rows were cleared in each environment. Unsupported DC cooling/water/equipment claims were removed. Haines City instead stores the published requested maximum 150,000 gal/day with estimated basis and explicit permit contingency; it is not measured use.

Five location changes required fifteen replacement USGS basemaps. Archer and Haines use Census-geocoded road intersections. Aurora uses EIA existing-plant coordinates in DuPage County; Percheron uses the nearby retired Boardman plant context while its actual parcel remains to the north; Sunstone uses the applicant construction-plan reference coordinates.

Crusoe’s exact published rural address and intersection produced no Census geocoder matches. Its existing marker is explicitly labeled city-area context pending the municipal parcel/site-plan polygon; its old Highway 47 address claim was removed.

Official gallery/linked-media checks: Archer operator supplies the conceptual six-building plan; Percheron project site supplies its historical ERM conceptual parcel layout, while an Adobe Stock picture was rejected; Sunstone ODOE supplies applicant Figure C-1, carrying historical Pine Gate branding predating the Amazon transfer. These are diagrams, not completed-site photographs. All three are credited and stored on Azure.

Chaska’s city page offers a campus concept but does not support a separate CloudHQ Building 2. No concept was copied to the held split. PointOne’s Lee County rendering/90 MW phase already belongs to corrected pin 16482; no unsupported Sanford South copy was retained.

Cielo operator domain failed DNS, including gallery/project access. Haines primary city letter was downloaded and both scanned pages inspected. Chisago City’s unnamed withdrawn purchase cannot be identified as Cielo without additional evidence. New Lenox FOIA email images were downloaded and visually inspected; they establish exploration and alternative properties, not the claimed 300 MW Route 30/Gougar site.

Swift Current’s Mineral Basin project page and county/operator Crusoe materials were checked; no additional verified project photograph was adopted. Public queues do not supply project photographs. Existing USGS images are maps with uncertain imagery dates, not evidence of construction.

Shared queue/source URLs are retained exactly in references and sourceUrl is null where needed; no synthetic URL fragments. Existing Sunstone overlap and West Gardner scope/ownership questions remain queued. No record merge or production deployment was performed.
Credit balance is not exposed by the available tools. Work stopped at a fully verified 24-record checkpoint.
